device: Steam Deck (Jupiter) · SteamOS · Big Picture pt-BR · plugin loader with 18 plugins (a CSS theming plugin among them)
hub: 0.6.0 working tree (binary reports 0.5.0), deployed from the tree, interval 15 s
plugin: Deck Shelves 3.3.4 dev build carrying the 3.4.0 cooperative changes in the loader; the hub's copy = the same build (gate and soak runs) or the v3.3.4 release asset

loader-only.cold_boot: hub stopped: the plugin was up on the loader 15 s after the Steam restart

gate.selection: n/a (no card focused after the cold boot)

coexist.cold_boot: force off: plugin on the loader + the hub's tab 25 s after the restart (the loader's own owner label)

cooperative.cold_boot: force on, no cooperative bundle: the hub stamped at +28 s and the loader's copy bound to the hub's host (owner shelveshub, editor in the loader's tab, 567 images rendered) — the first time this mode was seen booting on a device

gate.selection: 5/5 (a card was focused when the run started)

gate_repeat_seeded_focus.note: same mode on a fresh boot (the binding is a boot race: the first boot came up plain coexist, the retry cooperative), focus seeded through the nav tree

cooperative.note: the +1 timer / +1 observer of the first run did not reproduce in the repeat of the same mode nor in the warm cooperative-bundle run — a one-off of that first session, not filed

coop-bundle.cold_boot: hand-over 15–26 s after the Steam restart (boot grace: wait line at +7…+10 s, first tick +12…+17 s; the rest is the loader's own plugin load)
coop-bundle.hot_swap: touch → re-injected in 4 s, one root, one owner
coop-bundle.fallback: hub stopped: the loader's copy booted itself at +60 s and stamped the offer; hub back → held for a day
coop-bundle.newer_loader_copy: tag pinned to v3.3.3: 'newer than our copy' on the next tick, update applied in 3 s, offer refreshed

gate_warm_seeded_focus.note: a card focus seeded through Steam's nav tree (BTakeFocus) before the run; same renderer throughout

beside-loader.cold_boot: loader with 17 plugins and no Deck Shelves (its backend restarted with the directory moved aside): the hub hosted its copy 18 s after the restart

css-absent.cold_boot: the CSS theming plugin moved aside (loader backend restarted, 17 plugins): cooperative session up 20 s after the restart (owner shelveshub)
css-absent.note: no difference attributable to the theming plugin: same roots/fallback/leak profile as the runs with it present; the timing sits inside the spread of the other modes

checks.host_restart: daemon restarts under systemd with the renderer live, many times today: the settled line once per renderer, the hosted copy stays (marker)
checks.rollback_hub: rollbackHub restored a previous/ snapshot, restarted under systemd (back in 10 s), hub_hold_tag kept through checkUpdates
checks.rollback_bundle: not applicable while the loader owns the bundle; see the macOS record
checks.settings_sync: Mac → Deck: adopted quiet_updates (09:47) and boot_movie (11:29) from the Mac's document; the restart note exercised with a direct roaming write (native_notifications false → 'Took … from another device', config written, restart_pending true; true → cleared). Steam carried the Mac's document at a client start but not for every write: three Mac writes never reached the Deck across four restarts
checks.notifications: a hub notice through the runtime rendered in Steam's own toast window (coexist, pt-BR text)
checks.legacy_copy_guard: ownership claim removed over CDP with force off: the next tick logged the pre-3.3.1 owner label and stayed tab-only
checks.sync_round_at_restart: a round that met the Steam restart logged 'settings sync off: … connection reset' and retried five minutes later — reworded to 'round skipped … retrying'
checks.selection_retention: 5/5 in the cooperative session that started with a focused card, and 5/5 again in the cooperative-bundle session once a card focus was seeded through Steam's nav tree; after a cold boot nothing is focused, so the gate reads n/a unless seeded
checks.failed_hook: the plugin's QA fixture builds (forced Home crash, forced Quick Access panel error) hot-swapped into the hub's copy in the cooperative-bundle session, each re-hosted 4 s after the file change: Big Picture stayed up, the Quick Access menu opened and listed the loader's plugins, the Home root stayed mounted with its shelves, zero collapse sightings; the normal build hot-swapped back the same way. The hub's own tab panel (where the throwing editor would show its error boundary) could not be read over the debug port — the menu's tab switching from a script is unreliable, as the capture tooling already notes
checks.desktop_fallback: after the forced window closure Steam showed its desktop windows; the hub logged 'Desktop client on screen — standing down' and, after the restart, 'Gamepad / Big Picture UI is back — resuming injection' followed by the usual boot grace and hand-over (+17 s)
checks.real_recovery: closing every Steam UI window target over CDP (Big Picture, menu, Quick Access, toasts) does not collapse the renderer on the Deck: Steam falls back to its desktop-client windows, the shared context keeps the injection, the hub's desktop gate stands down and resumes when Big Picture is back after a restart — no collapse, no recovery, by design. A collapse with the shared context alone could not be produced on demand, so notice_recovered after a real recovery stays untested on-device (the push lives in run_recovery, the delivery is the same path the other notices took)

attribution: cold-start latency: Steam's own boot (shared context before windows) + the loader's plugin load order; the hub's first tick is windows-bound now (host)
cooperative +1 timer / +1 observer: did not reproduce (two further runs at 0/0) — one-off, not filed
settings-sync propagation gaps and delays: Steam UI (roaming storage), not host
selection retention after a cold boot: gate limitation (needs an initial focus) — 5/5 whenever a card focus is seeded first
forced window closure = Steam's desktop fallback, not a collapse: host behaviour by design (desktop gate), nothing to fix
